question:
What was the reason for the disruption in Third five year Plan?

I. Indo-Pakistan Conflict.

II. Two successive years of drought.

options.text: Neither I nor III तथा II दोनों

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Indo-Pakistan Conflict:** The **Third Five-Year Plan** (1961-1966) aimed to achieve self-sufficiency in food production and industrial growth. However, the outbreak of the **Indo-Pakistan War in 1965** significantly disrupted the implementation of the plan. Defense expenditure increased drastically, diverting resources from development projects. ***Hence, statement I is correct.***

• **Drought:** The Third Five-Year Plan also faced a severe setback due to **two consecutive years of drought (1965 and 1966)**. Agricultural production fell drastically, causing food shortages and inflation. This led to a major shift in focus from planned development to crisis management. ***Hence, statement II is correct.***
